svg.title: Playing with Fire: the world map
svg.desc: A pixel game world map at night in side view. On the grassy overworld a dotted path runs past levels 00 Press start, 01 Character, 02 Lore, 03 Inventory and 04 Kindling; a ladder leads down into a torch-lit cave with 05 Crafting, 06 Guild hall, 07 Quest log, 08 Boss fight and 09 New game plus, ending at a campfire save point. Pix waits at the start, a yellow cursor blinks over level 00.
